caption_L1: Number of firefighter injuries caused by fire in the United States from 1977 to 2018 is a line plot. Number of injuries is plotted on the y-axis. There is a linear scale of range 1980 to 2010 on the x-axis, labeled Year.
caption_L2L3: The chart shows a general trend of fewer injuries from 1977 to 2018, although this is not a steady linear reduction. The highest number of injuries, 110,000, occurred in 1977 and the lowest, just under 60,000, in 2018. There was little overall change between 1980 and 1990, then numbers started to fall.
